## Brand

Paper design style

## Style foundations

- Visual style: minimal, clean
- Typography scale: 14/16/18/24/32/40 | Fonts: primary=Roboto,
  display=Montserrat, mono=PT Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700,
  800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#111111, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Paper-textured, print-inspired design with minimal colors, clean serif/sans
typography, and tactile surface qualities.
